issues.evidence: The dark inserts at 24.07, 32.9 and 74.0 seconds have measured mean luma of 12.6, 11.9 and 15.4; the first two also have contrast of only 7.4 and 5.2. Their brief durations leave little opportunity to resolve the hand action.
issues.suggested_action: Verify these inserts in motion; selectively lift the hands and mouse while preserving blacks, and use a take with a visible monitor-side edge light if the action remains indistinct.

issues.evidence: The blue office shot at 00:05 has mean luma 36.5, followed by the nearly white chatbot at 00:08 with luma 202.8 and Word window at 00:12 with luma 199.0. The supplied UI frames fill most of the image with evenly illuminated white.
issues.suggested_action: Reduce the UI's apparent screen exposure and retain a consistent dark surround with directional screen spill, connecting these frames to the office lighting.

issues.evidence: The head-in-hands frames show dark hair merging into the black right background, while the cyan map and background figures remain conspicuous. The two supplied reaction views have nearly identical frontal framing.
issues.suggested_action: Lift the existing blue hair edge selectively, suppress the background map, and choose a tighter alternate crop for the second reaction.

issues.evidence: The prompt close-up places the assistant panel against the right edge and cuts off much of the surrounding app; the subsequent 'It finds.' frame shows a large document, a narrow assistant panel and substantial empty space on the right.
issues.suggested_action: Compose a deliberate two-part frame with the document on the left third and a larger assistant panel on the right third, using one controlled push toward the active area.

issues.evidence: In the regeneration frame, the red '8:45' clock overlaps the lower window and sidebar area, while 'Five minutes. For one number.' sits across the window's bottom boundary.
issues.suggested_action: Scale the window down enough to create a clear lower graphics band, placing the clock and sentence entirely within that band.

issues.evidence: The enlarged memo extends behind 'It fixes.' at the upper left, leaving part of the heading over the bright document edge; the page also exits the frame at the bottom.
issues.suggested_action: Reserve a dark top margin for the heading and frame the tracked-change paragraph beneath it, keeping the page edge clear of the title.

issues.evidence: The supplied 'Copy.' and piled-window frames show strong scale and angle changes across shots lasting 0.6–1.3 seconds, but still frames cannot establish smooth trajectories or natural motion blur.
issues.suggested_action: Verify the rendered sequence at normal speed; give each whip a consistent travel direction, readable landing frame and motion blur, correcting only moves that jitter or fail to settle.

issues.evidence: The review list is a narrow, straight-on vertical strip in a large dark field. The red ellipse and 'Slide 4. Caught.' callout create hierarchy, but the panel itself has little spatial separation.
issues.suggested_action: Add restrained panel-edge light and a soft contact shadow, then use a small push that settles on the circled row while holding the callout stationary.

top_revision: Unify the white illustration UIs and dark live-action inserts through consistent screen-motivated exposure, retaining readable hands, faces and interface focal points.

per_shot.fix: Verify visibility in motion; lift the hand locally and preserve a monitor-side edge.
Recover directional contrast on the fingers or select a more legible existing take.
Lift the mouse and clicking finger locally without raising the surrounding blacks.
Lower apparent screen exposure and retain a dark, directionally lit surround.
Frame the document within a darker screen surround and reduce the white-field dominance.
Create a dedicated lower band for the clock and sentence, clear of the window.
Rebalance document and assistant panel across thirds, with a controlled focal push.
Keep 'It fixes.' on dark negative space above the enlarged tracked-change paragraph.

evaluation_limits: SHARED.md, CINEMATOGRAPHY.md and the named brief files were not found in the available project tree. Assessment uses the supplied frames, shot timings and measured data; movement smoothness and shutter blur remain unverified.
